title: Summit Loan Status on Maturity, Satisfaction and Liquidation
content:
**Clause 1 — Due and payable.** A Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan becomes due and payable only when a maturity case on the loan has reached due-and-payable status; no HUD step applies to a Summit loan.

**Clause 2 — Paid in full.** A Summit loan is marked paid in full when a payoff case on it is satisfied under Borrower Voluntary Payoff, Heir Retention Payoff or Estate Market Sale Payoff.

**Clause 3 — Liquidated.** A Summit loan is marked liquidated when a payoff case on it is satisfied under Approved Short Sale Payoff or Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure.

**Clause 4 — Non-recourse.** Because the Summit loan is non-recourse, no balance above the satisfied amount is ever collected from the borrower or the estate.

## Schedule to Clauses 1 to 3

| Record that governs | Condition on that record | Status of the Summit loan |
|---|---|---|
| Maturity case on the loan | the case's status is due and payable | due and payable |
| Payoff case on the loan | satisfied under Borrower Voluntary Payoff | paid in full |
| Payoff case on the loan | satisfied under Heir Retention Payoff | paid in full |
| Payoff case on the loan | satisfied under Estate Market Sale Payoff | paid in full |
| Payoff case on the loan | satisfied under Approved Short Sale Payoff | liquidated |
| Payoff case on the loan | satisfied under Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure | liquidated |

The evidence for Clause 1 is the maturity case's own status as recorded, and the case must be one opened on that Summit loan. A maturity case that has not reached due-and-payable status does not make the loan due and payable; no HUD step forms part of the test.

## Notes on the clauses

- A loan that is active or whose draw period has expired may become due and payable or be paid in full; only a due-and-payable loan is liquidated.
- Under Clause 4, where a short sale or a deed in lieu satisfies the loan for less than its balance, the shortfall is not collected from the borrower or the estate. For illustration only: a hypothetical loan with a balance of USD 517930.26 satisfied for USD 468200.00 leaves USD 49730.26 that is never collected.
